title: EU AI Act Annex III Point 2 & NIS2: Critical Infrastructure, Smart Grid, Water & Utilities AI Safety Interlock

legalBasis.article: Annex III Point 2 (Critical Infrastructure) & Articles 9, 14, 15 + NIS2 Art. 21

coreObligation: AI systems intended to be used as safety components in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or water/gas/heating/electricity supply are High-Risk.
defaultNotChecked: Physical substation transformer oil dielectric breakdown
High-voltage transmission tower mechanical wind load fatigue

mcpTools.description: Halt out-of-envelope utility/infrastructure actuation and alert human dispatch.
